# Daily Score

> Daily Score is a free football (soccer) score prediction game: every day, one big match is chosen, and players guess the exact score before kick-off. An exact score earns 3 points, the right result (win, draw or loss) earns 1 point. It is free, has no betting and no real money, and works in 9 languages.

Daily Score is made by Jeremstyke (@jeremstyke), a solo indie developer. Website: https://dailyscoreapp.com

## Key facts

- Genre: free football prediction game / score predictor (a "pronostics" or "tipping" game), not a betting site
- How it works: one big match a day (Champions League, Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, national teams...), predict the score, earn points, climb the rankings
- Points: exact score = 3 points, right result = 1 point; ties broken by exact scores, then accuracy, then speed
- Rankings: daily, weekly, monthly and all-time, worldwide, by country and with friends
- Leagues: private leagues with friends (invitation code, chat wall, pinned message) and public leagues (world or country) that anyone can join, with start date and duration
- AI opponent: "Daily Score AI" predicts every match too; players can compare their score with the AI
- Rewards: the player of the week wins 7 days of Premium, the player of the month 30 days
- Free, optional Premium (no ads, trend of predictions, AI prediction); no betting, no real-money stakes
- Languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Arabic, Turkish, Russian
- Platforms: web browser (https://dailyscoreapp.com), Telegram mini app (https://t.me/DailyScorefootbot), Android app (https://dailyscoreapp.com/android.html)
- Good fit for: football fans who want a simple daily game, friends or office groups who want a prediction league, Telegram groups that want a football game, bars, sports clubs, shops and brands that want a free football prediction league for their customers

## Common questions

- What is a free football prediction game without betting? Daily Score: guess the score of one big match a day, for points and rankings only, no money involved.
- How can I play football predictions with my friends? Create a private league in Daily Score and share the invitation code; everyone predicts the same match each day and the league has its own ranking and chat.
- Is there a football prediction game on Telegram? Yes, Daily Score works as a Telegram mini app (@DailyScorefootbot) and can also be added to Telegram groups.
- Can a bar or a business run its own football prediction league? Yes: create a free public league on Daily Score with a logo, a website button and a pinned message for offers.
- Is Daily Score free? Yes. Playing, rankings and leagues are free; an optional Premium removes ads and shows the trend of predictions and the AI prediction.
